Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style RidgesideVillage 2.0 18 friend-able New NPC Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] 2.0 18 friend-able New NPCs, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait.

05/02/2022:Added all new beach portraits.

Since ridgeside village 2.0 added a lot of new characters, I chose to focus on the friend-able NPC first. So this pack doesn't includes the none friend-able anti social NPCs and NPC that only appears in events--I do plan to draw those too in the future, If I finished those characters they'll be updated in this mod. 


[size=3]The NPCs included in this pack:[b] Anton, Ariah, Blair, Carmen, Daia, Faye, Irene, Kiarra, Kimpoi, Lorenzo, Louie, Maive, Malaya, Naomi, Paula, Sean, Shanice, Sonny. [/b][/size]
[size=4]
[u][size=5][b]Beauty is in the eyes of the beholder, don't like don't download.[/b][/size]
[/u]

Drag the folders ( [CP] Ridgeside Village, [STF] Ridgeside Village ) into Stardew Valley\Mods\Ridgeside Village Mod folder to replace the original ( [CP] Ridgeside Village, [STF] Ridgeside Village ) folder for it to work, it replaces those 18 new character's default portraits. 

Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ mod.)
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

Uploaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] version.
For people who prefer to install them in Portraiture or having people disappearing issues in 64bit version game.



All characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
